notes.content:
After a year of development, “03.04” saw the light on the counter of the Steam store and now it can be purchased and saved in the game library.

A demo version will be available on Steam later.

At the moment the following is available in the game:

 Story mode. You can fully pass the story mode;
 Russian and English. In the settings you can switch between localizations.


Will be available in the following free updates:

 Hardcore mode. Complete the game without any firearm - only a knife and first aid kits;
 Arena mode. Unusual survival with endless waves (questionable) of opponents.


From minor errors (Will be corrected with subsequent updates):

 The text in contact with the closed doors was not translated into English (“It’s jammed / Need a key / There is no sense to go back”);
 The text in the tooltips, after changing the location and then loading the game, can be translated to the wrong language that was chosen before.


The game was developed by one person (with the exception of musical accompaniment) throughout 2018. The developer was inspired by the mod “Cry of fear” for the game Half-Life, its atmosphere in particular.

Responsible for the music:

 Enthuse Music;
 ApatiaKrai.


Wish you a pleasant game!
